copy.tagline: 发现组织中的积极偏差并提炼可迁移原则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用欣赏式探询方法挖掘团队成功经验并推广
copy.tagline_en: Discover positive deviants and extract transferable principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to use Appreciative Inquiry to uncover and spread team success patterns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用欣赏式探询方法搜索正面偏差，并提取可转移的原则和促成条件。
howto.when: 当你提出一个问题领域，希望用欣赏式探询发现正面案例并提炼原则时触发。

say.text: 帮我用欣赏式探询分析我们团队的创新案例。
say.note: Claude 会搜索正面偏差并提取原则。

say.text: 找出其他公司在客服方面的正面偏差。
say.note: Claude 会针对该领域进行发现。

say.text: 基于这些成功项目提取可复用的原则。
say.note: Claude 会输出促成条件和原则。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses Appreciative Inquiry to search for positive deviants and extract transferable principles and enabling conditions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you present a problem domain and want to discover positive deviants and principles using Appreciative Inquiry.

say_en.text: Analyze our team's innovation cases using Appreciative Inquiry.
say_en.note: Claude will search for positive deviants and extract principles.

say_en.text: Find positive deviants in customer service at other companies.
say_en.note: Claude will conduct discovery in that domain.

say_en.text: Extract reusable principles from these successful projects.
say_en.note: Claude will output enabling conditions and principles.
